name: Reimon
source:
An engmatic creature whom was first encountered during Takashi and his companions' search for the "Seven Wonders". Its thought to be some kind of magical creature, but its true identity is unknown. Highly intelligent and brimming with curiousity, it frequently disappears and makes Takashi & Co. anxious.

[Translation of its [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
